about: Commute flood hotspots in Bengaluru Urban (scripts/commute/build-hotspots.mjs): places on commuter roads with sourced news reports of waterlogging. Properties follow CommuteHotspot (src/commute/types.ts); `dates` lists every report date and `low` the lowness inputs. Reports are links only; coverage follows the news, so busy roads are over-represented.
licence: Positions and ways: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0 (extract 2026-10-17). Lowness: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (© DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018, provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA). Reports: links to the cited outlets.
